summary: Add fractal validate FILE... to validate KDL files offline and print declared subjects and mission revisions. This is not a deployment preview.

replay.detail: Offline validation reads authored files without opening a store or changing stored history.

schema.detail: No database, claim or configuration schema changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: New fractal validate FILE... command parses each file independently using the literal default host local, without configuration or a daemon. Text output lists subject kinds and IDs and mission id@revision values; --json returns subjects and missions arrays. Validation does not run gates, resolve live graph references, authorize publication or preview deployment. Existing commands and daemon protocols are unchanged.

downtime.detail: The new offline command requires no service interruption or migration.

manual.detail: No required steps. Optionally run fractal validate FILE... before publishing authored KDL.

recovery.detail: Validation persists no state; returning to the previous binary removes the command without a data migration.
